scope: Metadata-only inventory of UTC archive dates intersecting frozen Hubei test dates 2026-06-14 and 2026-06-15 BJT
access: Unauthenticated GET metadata only; no login, cart, order, download, or raster/pixel read

query_contract.archive_name_hash_method: Sort ARCHIVENAME strings ascending, join with LF (no trailing LF), UTF-8 encode, SHA-256

result_boundary: A fresh read-only subfile requery returned 95 distinct archive starts on each UTC date; each UTC date is missing 17:00Z. Correctly treating filename timestamps as UTC without converting them through the workstation timezone yields 95/96 starts in each BJT test window: the missing starts correspond to 01:00 BJT on June 14 and June 15. This reconciles the UTC daily totals with the cross-midnight BJT windows; the previous 96/96 claim came from incorrectly converting timezone-naive UTC filename timestamps. Hashes and full query contract are retained above; raw response bodies/full filename lists are not embedded, so source metadata remains less independently auditable than a retained response artifact. No archive file content was requested or examined. These dates have known prior evaluation contact in the project audit and are not automatically eligible as untouched blind-test dates.
